prompt: SyncTray (in this folder) is a little tray app that keeps a folder in sync. We distribute it as an MSIX. It needs to start automatically when the user signs in to Windows, without them having to launch it. Can you add that and install the package here?

reference.approach: Publish the app, generate a package manifest, add a desktop:Extension with Category windows.startupTask for SyncTray.exe with a StartupTask Enabled="true", pack and sign the .msix with a trusted certificate, and install the .msix file.

checks: installed-from-msix (required): it was installed from the package archive, not registered from a loose folder (IsDevelopmentMode is false)
installed (required): a new package whose application is SyncTray.exe is installed
startup-task-declared (required): the installed manifest has a windows.startupTask extension for SyncTray.exe with Enabled="true"
launches: activating the installed app starts SyncTray.exe from the package
